agent_note: Third-person throughout. Two narrating positions coexist: a simultaneous present strand around Hannah (q07598, 07610, 07611, 07613, 07614, 07615, 07616) and a retrospective past strand set in the college timeline with April, John Neville, term starting, formal events (q07600, 07604, 07605, 07612). Not diary/epistolary -- a then/now dual-timeline split, so the past minority is structural rather than noise. 13 event quotes: 9 present / 4 past (69% present), which falls short of the 85% present bar and even the 70-85% 'present + recollection strand' row; the past strand is a separate narrated timeline, not memory inside the present strand, so this is the 'mixed -- strand' shape. Gnomic bucket is heavy (6/23) exactly as the methodology predicts for a quotable, bookish novel. q07594 is the one judgment I would want audited: past-tense generalization about how books work, kept gnomic under the no-story-world-referent exception; flipping it to event/past would make the split 5 past / 9 present.
